environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on EKS. The ALB listener on port 443 is configured with mutual TLS authentication using a custom trust store (ACM PCA-issued CA). The ALB's MutualAuthentication attribute is set with Mode=verify, TrustStoreArn pointing to an ACM PCA subordinate CA that only issues certificates to three registered partner organizations (DN-validated via certificate policy OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.99999.1.2). Connection attempts without a valid client certificate signed by this specific CA receive TLS handshake failure at the ALB layer before any HTTP data reaches the target group. The X-Forwarded-Client-Cert-DN header is populated by the ALB only after successful mTLS handshake. Additionally, the EKS cluster has a Cilium NetworkPolicy restricting ingress to the reporting pod exclusively from the ALB's security group (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890), and the ALB security group only allows inbound from three partner CIDR ranges registered in a prefix list (pl-0123456789abcdef0).
